author: SpicyTunaRoll9
body:
I've been part of at least 8 clans. 
-Cacalmarin (Left due to excessive hating on ocn clans)
-Avicadian Heroes (Left due to rudeness and I felt alienated)
-Dino's Finest (Left due to main roaster inactivity and lack of scrim members, also the skype chat wasn't updated)
-Oblivion II (Disbanded)
-Atomic Warriors (Left due to unorganization)
-Phoenix (Disbanded my own clan because of lack of main roasters and too many people leaving.)
-Jamaican Bacon (Left due to various flame wars with other clans)

Don't take these reasons personally.
I have yet to find a clan that is right for me. I look for teamwork, general etiquette and manners, not clans that say "ez pvpiee nub scrubs get rekd" after every scrim.
-Pros
Can Op Stairbridging.
Fairly good at strafing
Napoleonic and WWII tactics to help lead the team into victory.
Have experience in all positions, but defence and rushing are my speciality.
Can communicate effectively.

Cons
Timezone GMT + 8. But I pull all-nighters every day since I don't have school so I can attend most scrims. If I can't I will notify you guys a week in advance or ASAP.
Lag on scrim servers. (350+) ping.
Pretty horrible at bow
